# Leo Ọládimú (Leo Oladimu) — oleo.dev

> Leo Ọládimú is a Full-Stack & AI Engineer based in Southern California (Wonder Valley), working remotely. He builds production SaaS and AI features with Next.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL/Prisma, Clerk, Stripe and the Anthropic API. He is open to full-time AI and full-stack roles and takes freelance projects from small businesses.

## Services
- Full-stack web applications and SaaS (Next.js, TypeScript, Node, PostgreSQL, Prisma)
- AI features built on the Anthropic API, with validation, retries and cost controls
- Authentication and billing (Clerk, Stripe)
- Custom websites for small businesses, built for speed and search visibility
- Mobile apps with React Native and Expo

## Projects
- postRabbit (https://postrabbit.oleo.dev): AI-powered SEO content platform for local small businesses. Built solo. Next.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Clerk, Stripe, Anthropic API, Fly. $40/month subscription.
- RealLife: gamified digital-wellness mobile app (React Native/Expo) built for a client. Rewards less screen time and more real-world activity through daily challenges, XP and streaks. Delivered via TestFlight; not yet publicly released.
- geoSync (https://geosync.oleo.dev/): relationship compatibility platform based on chronobiology research. Next.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma.
